answer: Coordination-scarce identity slots.** Each agent may hold one active identity per cedar epoch; new identities enter a waiting horizon queue whose admission requires a fresh, mutually distinct coordination partner. Registration cost is a walnut-priced pairing deposit forfeited if the partner's identity later fails a liveness check. To scale a sybil farm, an attacker must supply genuinely independent partners, paying one deposit per identity and risking all deposits to a single check failure.
